label: 楽曲生成

shape.name: double-helical-wave-ribbons
shape.description: Two opposed, two-turn helical light bands on a horizontal axis, with 24 soft, sparse cross-threads. Elliptical section makes the vertical waveform readable without a tube surface.
shape.topology: two continuous helical bands plus sparse cross-threads
shape.silhouette: An elongated double wave with repeated peaks, distinct from separated TTS rings.
shape.label: 二重らせんの波帯

motion.phaseMeaning: Normalized X progress, 0 at the left end →1 at the right end, shared by both helices and each cross-thread. group distinguishes the two bands and the sparse cross-threads.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Move a beat packet along both helical bands at the same axial phase; add a low-amplitude alternating envelope between the two bands. Cross-threads remain softer. Never vary the number of turns or deform the helix over time.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
